purpose: DEV-stage strategy-candidate screening only. This is NOT an EdgeLab economic gate, NOT LOGIC_VERIFIED criteria, and NOT a production promotion authority. It exists solely to decide which candidates carry enough DEV-stage evidence to justify a later, separate R2 freeze/EdgeLab campaign.
non_authority: Does not open or touch SEALED/OOS/FINAL_HOLDOUT data
Does not change strategies/registry.yaml or any production registry
amendment_policy: This file is immutable once committed. A policy change requires a new PREREG_ID and a new campaign; this file is never edited after a candidate has been replayed against it.

dev_datasets.notes: VALIDATION partition (2026-04-01 to 2026-07-01) of the same parent file is intentionally NOT used by this mission even though it is not locked, to preserve it for a future campaign. FINAL_HOLDOUT partition (2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31) is locked:true in its own manifest and is NOT opened, read, or used by this mission under any circumstance.

dev_datasets.role: DEV (package-level role not formally TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT-partitioned; not labeled OOS/SEALED anywhere in its own manifest)
dev_datasets.broker_source: REAL_OBSERVED_MARKET (MT5-derived from M1 authority, per package dataset_manifest.json)
dev_datasets.notes: Used only for INT_C002 (ST_MTF_CONTROL_SHIFT_V1), which needs a coherent D1/H4/H1/M15 stack from one source. H4/D1 are derived by this mission via simple OHLC resampling of the real H1 series (open=first, high=max, low=min, close=last), not a separate acquisition.

dev_data_not_available: GBPUSD, USDJPY, XAUUSD: no admitted multi-month OHLC history is physically present in this repository checkout; only a single point-in-time symbol-metadata snapshot exists (config/symbol_metadata/host_captured/*.json). DEV replay for these symbols is HOLD_SAMPLE_REQUIRED in this campaign.

BTCUSD, ETHUSD: no OHLC price history of any kind is physically present in this repository checkout; only a single point-in-time VT Markets symbol-metadata snapshot exists (spread, swap, contract size). DEV replay for crypto candidates is not possible in this environment and is not attempted; see data_capability_matrix.json.

cost_model.description: Point-in-time VT Markets Demo spread snapshots (config/symbol_metadata/host_captured/*.json, captured_at_utc 2026-09-30T15:12:03Z / 15:12:06Z) applied as a constant per-trade round-trip cost scenario. This is explicitly a SCENARIO, not a modeled average/representative spread and not a signed economic-gate cost authority.

scenario_base_spread_pips.BTCUSD: 17.02 USD (price units, not pips; digits=2, point=0.01, spread=1702 points)
scenario_base_spread_pips.ETHUSD: 2.50 USD (price units, not pips; digits=2, point=0.01, spread=250 points)

cost_model.commission_per_round_turn: UNKNOWN - no commission field exists in config/symbol_metadata/host_captured/*.json; never treated as zero. Candidates are friction-screened with commission explicitly flagged UNKNOWN.

slippage_assumption_pips.label: SCENARIO_ONLY, not sourced from a broker fill study

cost_model.funding_swap_crypto: VT Markets BTCUSD/ETHUSD use an overnight SWAP (CFD financing: swap_long=-20.0/-25.0, swap_short=0.0, per host_captured snapshot), NOT a perpetual-style funding rate. Any OSS crypto strategy source that assumes perpetual funding economics does not transfer to this venue without explicit translation; this is recorded, not resolved, in R1.

kill_policy.scope: DEV-stage screening only for this mission. Not EDGE_VERIFIED, not R6, not the signed config/governance/economic_gate_contract.yaml (which remains scoped to ST_SESSION_SWEEP_CONTINUATION_V1 only and is not modified or extended by this file).

thresholds.min_trade_count_rationale: EXISTING_PROJECT_CONVENTION, matches config/governance/economic_gate_contract.yaml sample.minimum_resolved_trades for a comparable DEV-stage minimum-evidence bar.
thresholds.max_single_trade_concentration_rationale: NEW_FOR_THIS_PREREG. If supported by sample size; if trade count is below min_trade_count this check is NOT_EVALUATED, not waived.
thresholds.friction_requirement: Net expectancy_R must remain > 0 under the BASE spread scenario above with commission UNKNOWN explicitly disclosed (not zeroed). The 2x STRESS scenario is reported for sensitivity only and is not itself a pass/fail gate in R1.

kill_policy.if_sample_too_small: HOLD_SAMPLE_REQUIRED. min_trade_count is never lowered after seeing a result.
kill_policy.amendment: Any change to these thresholds requires a new kill_policy_id in a new prereg file, never an edit of this one.

required: fixed initial stop loss known at signal time
at least one explicit profit target (TP1); TP2 required if the source rule defines a two-leg management structure
maximum 2 candidate signals per symbol per session/cycle
decision window of at least 5 minutes between signal and required action
fails_unless_redefined: dynamic ROI tables with no fixed target
unbounded trailing-only exits with no initial fixed stop

warmup_invariance_protocol.method: For each DEV-replayed candidate, run signal generation twice over the identical evaluation interval: once with a declared minimum warm-up (N bars of history consumed before the first evaluated decision) and once with 2N warm-up bars available before the same interval. Compare every decision (signal or NO_TRADE + reason_code) produced strictly after the declared warm-up boundary.
warmup_invariance_protocol.pass_condition: Decisions identical bar-for-bar after the warm-up boundary.
